summary: Lotwil Veriatus, busy with a set of shackles, sends you to speak with Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands. Lotwil needs a cog #5 and wants it brought back.

sections.title: Cog Number Five
sections.body: Lotwil glances up at you briefly, then bends over the shackles again. You are to go and speak to Lucien Tosselwrench, because Lotwil needs a cog #5 and asks you to bring it.

sections.title: Lucien's Verdict
sections.body: At the mention of cog #5, Lucien Tosselwrench is not hopeful about how things will go.

faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus, who is working on a set of shackles in the Badlands.
A cog #5, which Lotwil asks you to bring back after speaking with Lucien Tosselwrench.

faq.q: Who do I speak to about the cog?
faq.answer: Lotwil sends you to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
